newsitem.title: CANADA: Poor harvest weather weighs on UGG Q1.
newsitem.headline: Poor harvest weather weighs on UGG Q1.

text.p: United Grain Growers Ltd said on Thursday that a cold, wet Prairie harvest hurt crops and earnings in its first quarter ended October 31.

"Poor fall weather delayed the grain harvest, postponing shipping activity. Wet conditions and early snow had a negative effect on fall sales of fertilizer and other crop inputs," UGG said in reporting that its first-quarter loss narrowed to C$0.27 a share from year earlier C$0.34.
UGG said its operating income grow by eight percent in its grain handling business, although country shipments were "only nominally" above the first quarter of fiscal 1996.
"The late harvest was expected to skew shipping volumes into the final three quarters," UGG said.

It said it remained "optimistic fiscal 1997 earnings will be significantly above those achieved in fiscal 1996. The prospects of higher grain volumes and more positive economic conditions in the farm economy bode well for the company's business segments."
UGG fell 0.05 to 10.20 today on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
